provenance.what_each_row_is: one project's own posted minimum, which the site prints as 'Pay $X or more for this game', together with the currency the seller set, the genre the seller chose and the sale state at the moment of reading
provenance.what_is_deliberately_absent: no project descriptions, no cover images and no page markup. The fetched HTML stays on the machine that fetched it and is excluded from the repository, because a description is text its seller wrote while a title and a price are facts
provenance.what_it_is_not: not a transaction price: a buyer may pay above the minimum, and a project on sale is recorded at its sale price with the discount flagged
provenance.why_it_is_published: the site's listings change daily, so a later run reads a different column and the reading taken from this one could not otherwise be checked
